description:
GH: https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam/issues/17

`crates/kopi-beans/src/daemon/testkit/e2e.rs:3` got a line that is simply not
valid Rust:

    use crate as crate::daemon;

Bad artifact from the multi-crate -> single-crate collapse (old
`beads-daemon`/`beads-core` sub-crates became intra-crate modules). So
`--features test-harness` cannot parse at all, and `e2e-tests` (which enables it)
is dead too. Default build never notices because the module is gated at
`src/daemon/testkit/mod.rs:55` with `#[cfg(feature = "test-harness")]`.

Repro:
    cargo check --release -p kopi-beans --features test-harness

Knock-on already recorded in Cargo.toml: the `fault-proxy` feature exists as a
separate gate ONLY because `test-harness` is broken (see the comment at
crates/kopi-beans/Cargo.toml:141). Once this is fixed, revisit whether
`fault-proxy` should fold back into `test-harness`.

Fix = work out what the import was meant to say. Reporter deliberately did not
guess; check what `e2e.rs` actually references from the daemon module and
re-point it (likely `use crate::daemon;` plus whatever items it pulls).
title: kopi-beans: --features test-harness cannot compile (use crate as crate::daemon; in testkit/e2e.rs)
